title: RBI Issues Amendment Directions on Interest Rate on Deposits
description: The Reserve Bank, vide Press Release dated June 05, 2026, had issued the draft "Reserve Bank of India (Interest Rate on Deposits) Amendment Directions, 2026, seeking comments/feedback from the regulated entities and members of public/other stakeholders on or before June 20, 2026. The draft Amendment Directions proposed to provide greater flexibility to banks for pricing their Rupee bulk deposits, while ensuring uniformity in disclosure of interest rates on deposits. 2.
